The Briza meets the ANSI Z87.1 safety standard for optical quality and high mass/high velocity impacts making every outdoor adventure feel a little safer. The Briza goes great with New Generation XtrActive Transitions lenses, so bikers can wear one pair at night and during the day. description:
Ziena Verona Dry-Eye Prescription Glasses 

The Ziena Verona Dry-Eye Prescription Glasses have a patented moisture chamber that reduces tear evaporation and increases overall comfort for dry eye patients. The silicone shields insulate eyes from environmental triggers such as wind, dust, and air conditioning.  The patented eyecups are constructed of a soft silicone which forms a nice seal around your eyes. 

Bikershades always offers the most advanced lens technology. The Verona goes great with New Generation XtrActive Transitions lenses, so the wearer can use the same pair for day and night.

Ziena Verona Dry Eye Glasses Moisture Chamber 

The patented discreet silicone shield locks in moisture while blocking out wind, air, & other airborne irritants. Hidden magnets hold the silicone gasket in place for easy removal or replacement.  The silicone is soft and pliable, so it conforms to the curves of your face. 

The Ziena Dry-Eye Glasses can be worn without the gasket if you are not feeling any dry eye symptoms.   Choose from clear or black silicone gaskets.   

Ziena Dry Eye Glasses by 7eye – Stylish Relief for Dry, Irritated Eyes

Experience all-day comfort and relief with Ziena Dry Eye Glasses by 7eye, designed to prevent dry eyes, red eyes, and irritation caused by wind, dust, and dry environments. Featuring a removable moisture-retaining eye cup, these glasses create a protective seal around your eyes, reducing tear evaporation and shielding them from harmful elements.

Unlike bulky goggles, Ziena glasses combine fashion with function, offering a sleek, stylish design you can wear confidently in any setting—whether at work, outdoors, or on the go.

✅ Moisture chamber technology for maximum dry eye protection
✅ Removable eye cup for flexible wear and easy cleaning
✅ Blocks wind, dust, and allergens
✅ Ideal for dry climates, air-conditioned spaces, and digital device use
✅ Fashion-forward frames for men and women

Say goodbye to irritated, red eyes—Ziena by 7eye offers the perfect blend of clinical protection and modern style.

Ziena Verona Prescription Glasses Fit Medium Heads and fit most Large Heads   

The Verona fit Medium size heads very well.  To find the right size and fit, it is important to consider the frame dimensions as well as the curvature of your eyebrow bone & cheek bone. The various facial anatomies should be considered on how the eyecup will fit around the orbit of your eyes. Our Try Before You Buy Program is a great way to find the correct fit!

Medical Benefits of Ziena Dry Eye Glasses

Ziena and 7 Eye have proven results against serious ailments such as chronic dry eyes, Sjogren syndrome, Meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD), Ocular Rosacea, Bell’s palsy, A/C sensitivity, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS),  Superior limbic keratoconjunctivitis (SLK), blepharitis + more.

Ziena Dry-Eye Glasses are perfect for driving, riding your bike, or strolling along the beach.  We recommend using a lanyard or a string with a tightener to secure the glasses to your head.   You don’t want to lose them in high winds when riding a motorcycle.

description:
How Try Before You Buy Works:

Are you hesitant to spend 100s of dollars on prescription motorcycle glasses or goggles online because you don’t know if the frames will fit? Well, FEAR NO MORE! Now you can try on 5 to 10 pairs of our BikerArmour, WileyX, 7EYE prescription motorcycle eye wear frames in the comfort of your home BEFORE your prescription lenses made.  The cost for the service is only $29 which includes:

  • Based on your answers, our Experts will select a personalized collection of frames.
  • We ship the frames to you via FedEx 2 day 
  • We provide a FedEx 2 day return label.   
  • When you order your glasses, we’ll provide FREE shipping also!

Here’s how…

1.)Click on which brand(s) you want to try on. Obviously, the more brands of frames we want, the more the deposit will be. Then complete the order like any online purchase. Next, based on your answers, we’ll send you 5 to 10 frames to try on at home. You DO NOT select which frames you want sent to you. We’ll make this VERY EASY…don’t worry about a thang!

2.)We will require a deposit to cover the cost of the frames in case they are not returned.  When the frames are returned, we will apply the deposit towards the cost of your prescription glasses. If you decide NOT to order, we will refund the deposit (minus the modest $29 service fee for the cost of postage) 

3.)You will receive an email with easy to follow instructions. DON’T LOSE THIS EMAIL. Frames will be sent out in 2 to 3 business days.

4.)Try on and select the frame(s) that fit you best. Next, open the email and click on the ORANGE button that says “ORDER MY PRESCRIPTION GLASSES NOW.” You will also click on this button even if you decide NOT to order glasses. You will be taken to an online order form where you will indicate your favorite frame and choose the different lens options you like. Your Deposit will be applied to the cost of the glasses!

5.)Within 5 days of receiving the frames, send back ALL the sunglass frames using the original box and prepaid return postage label. If you do not order prescription glasses, we’ll refund your deposit minus the $29 service fee.

So that’s it. We did say it was easy, didn’t we? IF you have have any questions, please call us at (877) BIKER-21, and we’ll be glad to help!!!

description:
Magnum Motorcycle Sunglasses Multiple Pair Combos

Save time and money and purchase the Magnum Motorcycle Sunglasses Multiple Pair Combos.  With a combo, you will receive 2 or 3 sunglasses with different lens colors.  You will have a pair of sunglasses with dark lenses for riding in the day and a pair with yellow or clear lenses to ride at night.

Different Lens Colors For Riding During the Day and Night

GRAY LENSES: Compared to other colors, grey lenses filter out the most light while preserving true color. So, if you are sensitive to bright light, choose grey lenses. You should also consider polarized lenses if you want to eliminate glare.

CLEAR LENSES: Clear glasses provide natural view. These glasses are often used as safety glasses or for nighttime sports such as motorcycle riding, cycling, or playing baseball. Provides 100% UV Protection.

YELLOW NIGHT VISION LENSES: Yellow lenses reduce the halo effect around lights at night. They also enhance colors at night and sharpen vision. You will often find Shooting glasses with yellow tint to help increase contrast and clarity. Yellow sunglasses are excellent for motorcycle riding and cycling at night.

name: BikerArmour Barricade [MED – XLG]
description:
Barricade ANSI Z87.1 Safety Rated One Piece Lens Glasses with Foam Cushion

The Barricade ANSI Z87.1 Safety Rated One Piece Lens Glasses with Foam Cushion combine the best of motorcycle sunglasses with foam and without foam.  The sweatproof foam cushion is attached to the top of the frame.  This provides a seal on the brow line to prevent sweat from dripping into your eyes.  The foam also keeps the sunglasses firm and snug around your head.  You don’t want to lose your glasses in the wind.   

Motorcycle Shield Style Sunglasses with One Piece Lens Wraps Around Your Face Perfectly

Shield style sunglasses with one piece lens wraps around your face perfectly 180 degrees.  The wrap design blocks wind, dust and debris at all angles.  Polycarbonate lens construction are impact resistant and shatter proof.   There’s not foam cushion built around the entire frame, so if you want more breathability, the Barricade is an excellent choice.

ANSI Z87.1 Safety Rated Sunglasses with Foam Cushion for Harsh Working Conditions

ANSI Z87.1 Safety Rated Sunglasses with Foam Cushion can be used in work environments which require safety rated lenses.   The Barricade has passed ANSI Z87.1 standards which include ballistic tests, drop tests and shatter tests.  You can wear these for motorcycle riding as well as for work.  So if you work in harsh conditions, you can wear the same sunglasses for your motorcycle ride home.  

Different Lens Colors for Riding in the Night and Day

GRAY LENSES: Compared to other colors, grey lenses filter out the most light while preserving true color. So, if you are sensitive to bright light, choose grey lenses. You should also consider polarized lenses if you want to eliminate glare.

NATURAL CLEAR LENSES: Clear glasses provide natural view. These glasses are often used as safety glasses or for nighttime sports such as motorcycle riding, cycling, or playing baseball. Provides 100% UV Protection.

YELLOW NIGHT VISION LENSES: Yellow lenses reduce the halo effect around lights at night. They also enhance colors at night and sharpen vision. You will often find Shooting glasses with yellow tint to help increase contrast and clarity. Yellow sunglasses are excellent for motorcycle riding and cycling at night.

TINTED “ICE” LENSES: Tinted Ice Lenses filters out 5 – 10% more sunlight than non-tinted lenses.   The ICE tint also hides your eyes from your friends.  All lenses, whether they are clear, yellow or dark grey offer 100% UV protection.   The ICE tint allows you to wear yellow or clear comfortably in the day because it filters out some of the sunlight.

When exposed to sunlight, these biker glasses with BikerArmour Eclipse Photochromic technology transition from totally clear to gray in a matter of seconds. Or choose lenses that change from yellow to rustic brown. Yellow lenses help eliminate the “halo effect” around lights at night.

FOAM PADDED PROTECTION: Removable sweatproof foam cushion protects your eyes from wind, dust, and debris while you are riding your motorcycle. CDs are made of polycarbonate.

NON-SLIP RUBBER EAR PIECES: If you want to be on top of your game, you will need sunglasses that won’t slide off your nose, or fly off in the wind. Rubber ear pieces help secure the frame around your ears and are more comfortable for those long rides.

180 WRAP PROTECTION: Blocks UV rays, wind and debris from all angles. Wrap lenses also filter out UV rays that bounce off the inside of your lenses if the sun is behind you. Wrap sunglasses keep your eyes comfortable and safe. Great for cycling, runniig, motorcycle and convertibles..

CDs are made of polycarbonate.

FLEXIBLE FRAMES: Flexible frames are more comfortable and more giving behind the ears. These frames can fit larger head sizes.

180 WRAP PROTECTION: Blocks UV rays, wind and debris from all angles. Wrap lenses also filter out UV rays that bounce off the inside of your lenses if the sun is behind you. Wrap sunglasses keep your eyes comfortable and safe. Great for cycling, motorcycle and convertibles.

The Wiley X Enzo will make you the most stylish rider on the road. This motorcycle style wraps very closely around the face and blocks out light from every direction. description:
How Try Before You Buy Works…

Are you hesitant to spend 100s of dollars on prescription motorycycle glasses or goggles online because you don’t know if the frames will fit? Well, FEAR NO MORE! Now you can try on 5 to 10 pairs of our BikerArmour, WileyX, 7EYE prescription motorcycle eye wear frames in the comfort of your home BEFORE your prescription lenses made.  The cost for the service is only $29 which includes:

  • Based on your answers, our Experts will select a personalized collection of frames.
  • We ship the frames to you via FedEx 2 day 
  • We provide a FedEx 2 day return label.   
  • When you order your glasses, we’ll provide FREE shipping also!

Here’s how…

1.)Click on which brand(s) you want to try on. Obviously, the more brands of frames we want, the more the deposit will be. Then complete the order like any online purchase. Next, based on your answers, we’ll send you 5 to 10 frames to try on at home. You DO NOT select which frames you want sent to you. We’ll make this VERY EASY…don’t worry about a thang!

2.)We will require a deposit to cover the cost of the frames in case they are not returned.  When the frames are returned, we will apply the deposit towards the cost of your prescription glasses. If you decide NOT to order, we will refund the deposit (minus the modest $29 service fee for the cost of postage) 

3.)You will receive an email with easy to follow instructions. DON’T LOSE THIS EMAIL. Frames will be sent out in 2 to 3 business days.

4.)Try on and select the frame(s) that fit you best. Next, open the email and click on the ORANGE button that says “ORDER MY PRESCRIPTION GLASSES NOW.” You will also click on this button even if you decide NOT to order glasses. You will be taken to an online order form where you will indicate your favorite frame and choose the different lens options you like. Your Deposit will be applied to the cost of the glasses!

5.)Within 5 days of receiving the frames, send back ALL the sunglass frames using the original box and prepaid return postage label. If you do not order prescription glasses, we’ll refund your deposit minus the $29 service fee.

So that’s it. We did say it was easy, didn’t we? IF you have have any questions, please call us at (877) BIKER-21, and we’ll be glad to help!!!
